description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 22.05.2017 to 28.05.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments/subsidiary legislation, and involves compliance requirements for import/export activities - all characteristics of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
